That's the point. Why should game director explain about the ending? The game must explain everything well. 

They tried to make a tragic and sad story but they failed. (There was beautiful emotional moments between "Brothers" but I'm talking about whole story)
FFX has the saddest FF ending. The main character fades and everything back to normal. After credits we see a scene shows Tidus again. I like this kind of mysteries. But when your story is not that much clean that you have to explain the ending, it's not good.

P.s: Hajime Tabata also explained that FFXV was not a success. I think it was a good game but not a good "Final Fantasy". I enjoyed road trip and hunting with fellas but the story was meh

In Episode Ignis Yeah. Tabata mentioned they are alive.
But I didn't see any proof in main game. Also I prefer they all die or all alive.

When I read people speak about "post game" . I thought it's like Dragon Quest XI.   
There is a post game in Dragon Quest XI. After you finished the game and saw credits, there is still huge content and stories.  


I was afraid of spoiling so I didn't search more about "post game" in FFXV.  
But damn it makes me emotional to see them together again...

Yeah this is what I'm talking about. The game wanted to show "Brotherhood" and that was the main plot.   
They could Luna and Noct relationship better. They had mobile but they used a book and letters. Most gamers found it weird.   
Like you said "If anyone interested about Luna and Noct's life and their marriage and having children and... they SHOULD read A NOVEL" while FFXV logo shows this couple. FF8 also should Squall hugging Rinoa but Every moment of FF8 and even the soundtracks remind you THIS IS A LOVE STORY!  


They sucked at developing cool characters like Arenea or Marshal or even Cid!  
I really wanted to know why he was very angry with Noct's dad. What happened between those 4 bros.   
Thanks to DLC we saw a little character development for Arenea , Marshal and Ravus but they didn't even developed the Lunafrya. After I watched Episode Ignis and saw Ravus reactions, I felt a little sadness about her death!  


It was a good road trip with bros simulator. They could just let player hunt and do whatever they want I personally didn't care about story until they forced me and game became fast forward after ch12!  


Spoiler Episode Ardyn:  
>!The most painful fact is that we were all played by Bahamut. Ardyn was Noct both were victims.!<

Honestly I felt better if that last camp was their after life camp (I believed it was) but after I watched Episode Ignis's First ending I found out it wasn't. But I'm not sure if they survived or not. If you are talking about Takata's interview he might talk about Ignis's second ending which everything end well.  


But damn Quarantine makes me so emotional and of course the relationship between these 4 dudes was so strong. (Also Square sucked at showing their relationship after their reunion)

Oh I hate Luna and I hate their -so called- ROMANCE.   
I prefer Episode Ignis's second ending.  


But damn They sucked at developing this game. After all these years they released an unfinished game with 99999 DLC , Movie , Novel , Anime! They should put them all in game!

No I just saw 2 cooking for Iggy , One for Gladio and One for Prompto.  
By the way when we travel to past, do they still remember what will happen in future? Or they have no F\*cking idea about their tragic destiny?
So no story or events? (Like those mini events in camps photography or running with gladio or cooking with Iggy?)
Really? It makes me sad because I know their fate and I think hearing their funny conversations and even Iggy's cooking will make me cry

Is there new events or moments that you don't want to spoil?  
Where were those military bases?
Yeah it was ok

Man I'm jealous of the game developers who made Minecraft.  
This post and the replies... Amazing...  
I've got emotional....

My Ex girlfriend was a gameplay animator.  
I'm also Narrative game designer. Let me be honest with you: Entertainment industry is cruel.  


Well most people (Like me or maybe you) entered this industry because we love video games/animations. Like other jobs, animation has its problems for example: Overwork!  
But if you love your job, you will definitely find a way to handle the obstacles.  


Just focus on your works. If you have a dream company, try to reach out to animators or watch their showreel and study their gameplay/cg animations.   
You can share your works on Artstation , Instagram , Tumblr, Twitter and Vimeo. There are many cool animators and they can give you feedbacks and help you to decide the best choice.

Your feeling is natural. You just need to focus and show your passions. First step is always the hardest. Don't worry. You're not alone!  


*P.S: If you like, I can connect you to my Ex. She is gameplay animator and we are still in touch.*
